name: @daynori/mobile
description: Expo React Native mobile application for Daynori (Android + iOS native shells)

scripts.prebuild: expo prebuild --no-install -p android && node -e "if (!require('fs').existsSync('android/build.gradle')) { console.error('Native android generation failed'); process.exit(1); }" && node ../../scripts/mobile-android-release-path.mjs inspect --android-dir android
scripts.prebuild:ios: node -e "if (process.platform !== 'darwin') { console.error('iOS prebuild requires macOS + Xcode'); process.exit(1); }" && expo prebuild --no-install -p ios && node -e "if (!require('fs').existsSync('ios')) { console.error('Native ios generation failed'); process.exit(1); }" && node ../../scripts/mobile-ios-path.mjs inspect
